_readme: Local switches for testing. Copy this file to Local/switches.json (git ignores Local/). The game reads it at the start of each scene and each Cut; a missing file means every switch is off. autoplay: the human seat sends the canned lines in Content/NHOS/Data/autoplay.json instead of waiting for typed input. force_tie: The Cut rewrites the vote targets into a cycle, so every actor on stage gets one vote and the tie cuts nobody. The reactions still run and the scene still counts, so a show with force_tie on plays every scene and ends after the last one with the human still on stage. Set it back to false before a person plays. spare_human: The Cut moves every vote for the human to another actor on stage, so the human is never cut and a show plays all its scenes (for testing the scene 2 path and the win screen; a moved vote keeps its old reason). mode: free, relay or keys. free makes no LLM call: the AI players answer with the pre-written lines in Content/NHOS/Data/free_mode.json, and no tokens are spent. relay sends every ask to our relay, which holds our keys and costs money. keys calls each provider directly with the keys in Local/llm_key.json and needs keys for at least 3 of the 4 providers. It is read once when the show loads, and it decides the mode for autoplay runs, which skip the title screen. On the title screen, the three buttons override it. A missing or unknown mode means free. burn_test: Test for Free calls the money burn (a bill burning in the bottom-right corner, which normally marks each relay reply) for every ask too, so its look can be checked without spending tokens. Set it back to false before a person plays. fast_lines: cuts every wait of the line queue (Content/NHOS/Data/pacing.json) to a tenth, so an autoplay check runs fast. It is read at the first line of a run. Set it back to false before a person plays. ai_seats: seat only this many AI actors (3 or more), dropped at random from those that can sit, for a 4-actor test show; 0 or missing seats every AI that can sit. It is read at each show's draw. Set it back to 0 before a person plays. error_test (T37): in Test for Free, fail one actor ask per turn with a canned reply body for this case, the name of an entry in test_replies in Content/NHOS/Data/errors.json (out_of_credits, rate_limited, overloaded, overloaded_json, key_rejected, no_reply, cut_off, refused, unreadable, relay_429, relay_provider, unknown), sent through the client's real error path, so each backstage note can be checked without spending tokens. It is read once when the show loads. Set it back to empty before a person plays. analytics (T68): "off" sends no analytics event; "test" sends them marked "test": true, from the editor too, and Tools/analytics_report.py leaves them out unless given --test; missing or "" sends them only from a packaged build, as a player's game does (the editor sends none). An autoplay run sends only when it is "test". It is read once when the game loads. Keep it "off" on a dev machine. emote_test (T75): every robot cycles through every emotion in Content/NHOS/Data/emotes.json by itself from BeginPlay, 4 seconds each, each robot starting at a different one, with no LLM and no show needed, so the faces can be screenshot. It is read once at BeginPlay. Set it back to false before a person plays.
